Sure! Here’s a simple yet flavorful way to make an **Indian‑style steak** at home.  
Feel free to adjust spices to your taste.

---

## Ingredients  

| Item | Quantity |
|------|----------|
| Ribeye / New York Strip steak (1–1.5 lb) | 1 piece |
| Salt | ½ tsp (to taste) |
| Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| Garlic cloves | 2–3, minced |
| Fresh ginger | 1 tbsp, grated |
| Red chili powder | 1 tsp (adjust for heat) |
| Garam masala | ½ tsp |
| Turmeric powder | ¼ tsp |
| Ground cumin | ½ tsp |
| Coriander powder | ½ tsp |
| Lemon juice | 1 tbsp |
| Yogurt (plain, Greek or thick) | ¼ cup |
| Butter | 2 tbsp |
| Olive oil or vegetable oil | 1 tbsp |
| Fresh cilantro (optional) | 1 tbsp, chopped |

> **Tip:** If you prefer a milder version, reduce the red chili powder or use paprika instead.

---

## Marinade (Optional but recommended)

1. In a bowl, combine yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, salt, pepper, red chili powder, garam masala, turmeric, cumin, and coriander.  
2. Add the steak, coat it evenly, cover, and refrigerate for **at least 30 min** (up to 4 h).  
   *If you’re short on time, skip the yogurt and just rub the spice mix onto the steak.*

---

## Cooking Steps

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | **Preheat** a cast‑iron skillet or heavy pan over high heat until smoking hot. |
| 2 | **Pat** the steak dry with paper towels; this helps achieve a good sear. |
| 3 | **Season** the steak with salt & pepper (if not marinated). |
| 4 | **Add** 1 tbsp oil to the pan; swirl to coat. |
| 5 | **Sear** the steak for 2–3 min per side for medium‑rare (adjust time for desired doneness). |
| 6 | **Lower** the heat to medium, add butter, and spoon the melted butter over the steak while it finishes cooking. |
| 7 | **Rest** the steak on a cutting board for 5 min before slicing. |
| 8 | **Serve** sliced against the grain, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired. |

> **Doneness guide (for a 1‑inch thick steak):**  
> - Rare: 120–125 °F (48–52 °C) – 2 min per side  
> - Medium‑rare: 130–135 °F (54–57 °C) – 3 min per side  
> - Medium: 140–145 °F (60–63 °C) – 4 min per side  
> - Well done: 160 °F+ (71 °C+) – 5 min per side

---

## Serving Suggestions

| Side Dish | Pairing Idea |
|-----------|--------------|
| Naan or roti | Warm flatbread to scoop up juices |
| Basmati rice | Fluffy rice seasoned with saffron or cardamom |
| Cucumber raita | Cool yogurt dip with cucumber, mint, and a pinch of cumin |
| Grilled veggies | Bell peppers, onions, and zucchini tossed in olive oil & spices |

---

### Quick Variations

| Variation | How to tweak |
|-----------|--------------|
| **Spicy steak** | Increase red chili powder or add finely chopped green chilies. |
| **Herb‑infused** | Mix chopped rosemary or thyme into the spice blend. |
| **Smoky flavor** | Add smoked paprika or a splash of liquid smoke to the marinades. |

Enjoy your delicious Indian‑style steak! Let me know if you'd like a side dish recipe or tips on how to pair it with drinks.
